newsitem.title: JAPAN: DDI'S PHS UNIT SAYS NEW SUBSCRIBERS DOWN IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: DDI'S PHS UNIT SAYS NEW SUBSCRIBERS DOWN IN JULY.

text.p: DDI Corp's personal handy phone system (PHS) unit said on Friday that the number of new subscribers totalled 60,400 in July, down sharply from 128,700 in June.
A spokesman for DDI Tokyo Pocket Telephone Inc said the decline in new subscribers was partly due to a shortage of some popular models of PHS phones.
He said the number of new subscribers also declined as many high school and college students, who account for a large proportion of PHS subscribers, prepared for the exam season in July.
